name: Hello, Ai
tagline: Your unbiased guide to the world's smartest AIs
author: Clement Machado
affiliations: Hello, AI is run by Clement Machado. I have no financial or employment relationship with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Meta, Alibaba or OpenAI: no equity, no payments from them, no sponsorship, and no free credits or early access. The weekly update and the article drafts are produced with the help of AI models, including Claude and Grok, so two of the vendors on the list are also tools I use. That is a reason to check my work against the published method. I also run the HelloAI app at app.helloai.com, a separate product. Links to it from this site are labelled "our app". The model rankings are not affected by it.
listing_policy: I track a hand-picked set of frontier models, capped at six. A model is added when its own LMArena text-overall Elo is within 25 points of the lowest model that has an Elo of its own and has held there across two consecutive published snapshots. When a new model is admitted, a model without an Elo of its own is the first to make way; otherwise the lowest-rated one does. The same rule applies to every vendor. A model that has no Elo of its own yet is shown as "not yet rated" and is not ranked, and I never show a predecessor's score as its own.
